records.subject: Re: Bulk import

decisions.rationale: Signed up 6 days ago, first project reached day 3 (real activity), Team plan active, 8 days left. But no invites sent, key milestone unreached, no tickets, and Owen never replied to either outreach [email:a744b821], [email:d9e856f0] — silent single-user accounts often stall.

draft.subject: One next step for Harbor Partners
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Following up on my last note — your first project in Wrenfield is a good start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next thing that usually makes it click is getting a colleague in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your project setup and the best way to bring your team in.

Best,
Priya
